title: Decoding the role of the soft palate in sleep-disordered breathing: A static magnetic resonance imaging study integrating novel and conventional measurements
html: This study aimed to systematically evaluate soft palate metrics using conventional and novel standardized magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) measurements, to explore the correlation between the novel indicators and sleep-disordered breathing (SDB) severity, and to preliminarily assess their predictive value for SDB.
